notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Added sprinting using L.Shift.
Added the ability to select controls relative to the sight of the player's choice.
Steam achievements work correctly.
The design of the main menu has been changed.
Now the character does not automatically hit with the butt if the magazine runs out of ammo.
Some bugs have been fixed.
